# Security policy

If you believe you've found a security issue affecting [pekmen.net](https://pekmen.net), please report it privately to **contact@pekmen.net**.

Include the affected URL or component, steps to reproduce, and the potential impact. Please avoid sharing exploit details in public GitHub issues.

Do not test against other users' data, interrupt the production service, or perform denial-of-service testing.

Security fixes are reviewed and released as needed. There is no fixed public support window or guaranteed response time.

The site's machine-readable contact information is available at [security.txt](https://pekmen.net/.well-known/security.txt).
